Ogre Barbarian 7
CR 10

XP 9,600
Male Ogre Barbarian 7
CE large humanoid (giant)
Init +1; Senses Darkvision 60 ft, low light vision, Perception +8

AC 15, touch 8, flat-footed 14 (+2 armor, +1 Dex, +5 natural, -2 rage, -1 size)
hp 147 (4d8+7d12+7 Favored Class,+22 rage, +11 Toughness, + 44 Con);

Combat Gear Potions of Cure Serious Wounds (2) Other Gear +1 Human Bane Ogre Hook, Bracers of Armor +2, Belt of Giant Strength +4

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Unraged Statistics (N/A)

DEFENSE: AC 17, touch 10, flat 16; hp 125; Fort +13, OFFENSE: +1 Human Bane Ogre Hook +21/+16 (2d8+16/19-20/x3) vs humans: +23/+21 (2d8+18+2d6/19-20/x3);
